description: Query your financial data. Pick ONE view with `view`: `statements` lists your royalty statements, paginated — `filters`: label_id, release_id, isrc, upc, start_date/end_date; group_by="release" rolls totals up per release. `statement_detail` retrieves one statement by `invoice_number` (required). `transactions` lists account transactions, paginated — same `filters` and `group_by`; sort with `sort`. `royalty_breakdown` returns a cursor-paginated royalty breakdown — `group_by` is REQUIRED for this view: a comma-separated, ordered subset of: track, dsp, release, territory, period (e.g. "release,dsp"); same `filters`; pass `cursor` to page. Use download_statement for statement line items (CSV) or the invoice PDF. response_format:'detailed' returns the verbatim API response.

filters.description: Filter names → values, passed through verbatim.

group_by.description: Required for royalty_breakdown; "release" rolls statements/transactions up per release.
